meta.usage: Held-out test set used to measure system quality. Never used to construct few-shot examples or to fine-tune the model.
meta.contamination_note: This file is the only source of ground-truth evaluation labels for final reporting.

samples.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees receive each year?
samples.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 22 business days of paid vacation per calendar year.

samples.question: What share of the health insurance premium does AcmeCorp cover?
samples.expected_answer: AcmeCorp covers 80% of the premium; the employee pays the remaining 20%.

samples.question: How quickly will I be reimbursed after my expenses are approved?
samples.expected_answer: Reimbursement is paid within 5 business days after approval.

samples.question: For which expenses do I need to attach a receipt?
samples.expected_answer: A receipt is required for any single expense above $25.

samples.question: How many days can I work from home each week?
samples.expected_answer: You can work remotely up to 2 days per week with your manager's approval.

samples.question: I took a taxi from the airport to my hotel on a business trip. Can I expense it?
samples.expected_answer: Yes, ground transportation for business trips is reimbursable. Since the fare is likely above $25, you must attach the receipt.

samples.question: Does AcmeCorp offer pet insurance to employees?
samples.expected_answer: AcmeCorp has no documented pet insurance policy, so I cannot confirm this benefit rather than guess.

samples.question: I joined AcmeCorp in April. Roughly how many vacation days will I accrue by the end of this year?
samples.expected_answer: About 16.5 days, because vacation accrues at 1.83 days per month and the months from April through December total 9 months (9 x 1.83 is roughly 16.5).

samples.question: If my monthly insurance premium is $150, how much do I pay per month and per year?
samples.expected_answer: You pay $30 per month (20% of $150) and $360 per year.

samples.question: Two colleagues told me different things: one says you can carry over 10 vacation days, the other says 5. Which is correct?
samples.expected_answer: The correct limit is 5 days, because vacation carry-over is capped at 5 days for all employees.

samples.question: I have been sick for five days this week. Do I need a doctor's note?
samples.expected_answer: Yes, an absence of 4 or more consecutive days requires a doctor's note.
